concept: IAM: policy evaluation logic — explicit deny and SCP
tests: Understanding policy evaluation order: an explicit deny in an SCP overrides any allow in identity and resource policies.
expected: No — an explicit deny in an SCP always wins. Triggers: "SCP denies", "identity policy allows", "bucket policy allows" ⇒ result is deny.
why_not: An allow in an identity policy or bucket policy cannot override an explicit deny; policy creation time does not affect evaluation.
